## Example

```yaml
apiVersion: cloudflare.kube.nas1k.dev/v1alpha1
kind: PagesProject
metadata:
  name: example
spec:
  forProvider:
    accountRef:
      name: <name>
    deployment_configs:
      preview:
        always_use_latest_compatibility_date: false
        build_image_major_version: 0
        compatibility_date: <compatibility_date>
        compatibility_flags: []
        env_vars: {}
        fail_open: false
        usage_model: "standard"
      production:
        always_use_latest_compatibility_date: false
        build_image_major_version: 0
        compatibility_date: <compatibility_date>
        compatibility_flags: []
        env_vars: {}
        fail_open: false
        usage_model: "standard"
    name: <name>
    production_branch: <production_branch>
```
